ia.chave_placeholder: Free key (kept only on this computer)
ia.ajuda_titulo: How to sign up for free on OpenAI and get an API key
ia.ajuda_texto:
1. Create a free account at platform.openai.com (you can sign in with Google, Microsoft, or email).
2. Open API Keys and click Create new secret key.
3. Copy the generated key (starts with sk-) and paste it above. Your key stays stored only on this computer.
ia.exemplo: A keyboard with the vowels of the alphabet, in large letters.
ia.aviso_internet: Internet access is required to use this feature. It is not available offline.
